verdict: Yes, as a community-focused brand. Singh Styled pitched grooming products for Sikh men who keep uncut hair on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. The community is large and spread worldwide, and few brands design for them.
angle: Beard oils, turban accessories and hair products designed for uncut hair serve Sikh men in India and abroad. Community trust and respect for religious identity are essential. Diaspora markets add export potential.
